title: Falcon Spawners
description: A powerful Minecraft spawner management plugin with economy integration, interactive GUIs, and persistent storage. Buy, sell, and trade mob spawners with Vault support. Based on DonutSMP Spawners.
body:
## Falcon Spawners
**This plugin is the same as the DonutSMP Spawners with these features:**

> 🎯 **Mob Spawner Management** — Manage and customize mob spawners on your server

> 💰 **Economy Integration** — Buy, sell, and trade spawners using Vault-supported economy plugins

> 🖥️ **Interactive GUIs** — User-friendly graphical interfaces for spawner management and filtering

> 💾 **Persistent Storage** — Database support (SQLite by default) for saving all spawner data

> 📦 **Extensive Configuration** — Customize spawner types, pricing, and behavior via config files

> ⚡ **Folia Support** — Optimized for modern async-capable server implementations

> 🔌 **Soft Dependencies** — Optional integration with Essentials and CoinsEngine

---

### Requirements
- Minecraft **1.21+** (tested on 26.1.2)
- Java **21+**
- [Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.41918/) + an economy plugin (EssentialsX, or CoinsEngine.)

### Commands
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/spawners` (alias: `/ss`) | Opens the spawner GUI |

### Permissions
| Permission | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `falcon.spawners.admin` | Admin access for spawners | OP |

---

### Changelog — v1.6
- Updated to support Bukkit/Paper 26.1.2
- Java 21 support added
- Added extensive pricing configurations for mobs, ores, crops, and more!
